set.body:
Repair the demonstrated rename-between-pages defect in the existing directory cursor contract.

Acceptance criteria

1. With page size one, rename A to AA after page one. An old cursor produces the documented restart response or a complete authorized traversal without a repeated or skipped record.
2. Use consistent ordering keys, tie-breakers and normalization for labels, empty names and same-name results. Altered principal, scope and filter cannot reuse a cursor outside its contract.
3. Revocation and expiry between pages immediately remove affected results and counts. Hidden-only mutations leave the authorized response consistent with the disclosure contract.
4. Reference and PostgreSQL-backed directory fixtures produce the same stable sequences and restart behavior.

Verification

Keep the A→AA regression and changed-access paging fixtures with exact expected IDs and totals.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: ARC03: Make directory pagination stable across renames and access changes
